keyResults.statement: Demonstrate cell-to-cell uniformity across the 10-cell build
Validate the accelerated stress-test protocol v2
Hold H₂-in-O₂ crossover under 1% at 30 bar
Freeze the porous transport layer spec

stageGates.name: Build and leak-test the stack
stageGates.intention: Prove the stack holds 30 bar before any durability hours are spent on it.

stageGates.name: Durability screen, 500 h
stageGates.intention: Show the decay rate stays under 10 µV/h with crossover in spec.

stageGates.name: 1,000 h endurance hold
stageGates.intention: Hold the decay rate for a full 1,000 hours.

stageGates.name: Post-test teardown and SEM
stageGates.intention: Look for membrane thinning and catalyst migration.

stageGates.name: Failure-mode review
stageGates.intention: Close out the FMEA with teardown evidence.

stageGates.name: PTL spec review
stageGates.intention: Agree the PTL porosity and thickness window with the supplier.
stageGates.overrideJustification: Signed off in the Oct 9 design review; supplier data accepted in lieu of our own porosity scan.

stageGates.name: Second-source bipolar plate trial
stageGates.intention: Contact resistance inside the 6 to 10 mΩ·cm² window.

stageGates.name: Design freeze sign-off
stageGates.intention: Every component locked and released to purchasing.

risks.problem: Seal creep at 80 °C lets hydrogen into the oxygen loop

knowns.text: Gasket thickness varied by up to 0.06 mm across the stack at build.
PTFE coupons lost about 12% compression set after 200 h at 80 °C.

modes.mode: Gasket relaxes and loses seal compression

effects.effect: H₂ in O₂ climbs past the 1% safety limit

causes.cause: PTFE creeps above 70 °C under the 30 N·m clamp load
causes.mitigation: Trial EPDM gaskets on cells 6 to 8 and re-torque at 100 h.

experiments.hypothesis: PTFE gaskets lose compression above 70 °C; EPDM holds it.
experiments.test: Compress coupons to the stack clamp load, hold 200 h at 80 °C, then measure compression set and helium leak rate.
experiments.notes: The EPDM-2 leak check is booked for Oct 15.
experiments.conclusion: PTFE lost about 12% compression set; EPDM held under 5%. Cells 6 to 8 move to EPDM for the rebuild.

causes.cause: Gasket thickness varies by up to 0.06 mm across the stack
causes.mitigation: Measure every gasket before the rebuild.

experiments.hypothesis: A 0.2% offset on the H₂-in-O₂ sensor would hide the early climb.
experiments.toggle: Sensor as installed or freshly calibrated
experiments.test: Feed 1.0% H₂-in-O₂ calibration gas before and after calibrating the sensor.
experiments.notes: Calibration is booked with the sensor task.

effects.effect: The stack trips the crossover alarm during the 500 h screen

causes.cause: Crossover sensor drift hides a slow leak
causes.mitigation: Calibrate the H₂-in-O₂ sensor before hour 0.

experiments.hypothesis: Thermal cycling between 20 and 80 °C, not steady heat, drives the creep.
experiments.test: Two coupon sets for 100 h each; measure compression set every 25 h.

risks.problem: Cell 7 runs 40 mV above the stack average

knowns.text: Cell 7 sat 40 mV above the stack average at first light.
Cell 7 HFR reads about 9 mΩ·cm² above cells 6 and 8.

modes.mode: Cell 7 voltage keeps rising under load

effects.effect: The stack misses the 10 µV/h decay target at 500 h

causes.cause: Poor PTL-to-catalyst contact under a thin gasket
causes.mitigation: Fit a measured gasket on cell 7 at the rebuild.

experiments.hypothesis: The cell 7 membrane was pinched during assembly.
experiments.test: Isolate cell 7 and measure hydrogen crossover current at 30 bar.
experiments.notes: Within the 1.0 to 1.3 mA/cm² band of the other cells.
experiments.conclusion: No sign of membrane damage on cell 7.

experiments.hypothesis: Cell 7 has higher contact resistance than its neighbours.
experiments.test: Map HFR at 1 kHz on cells 6, 7 and 8 at 1 A/cm².
experiments.conclusion: Cell 7 reads 9 mΩ·cm² higher, but build 1 had a similar spread. Repeat after the rebuild.

knowns.text: Spare PTLs were ordered Oct 5 and arrived Oct 12.

modes.mode: Spare PTLs arrive too late for the rebuild

effects.effect: The 1,000 h hold slips past the quarter

causes.cause: Supplier lead time stretched to 10 weeks
causes.mitigation: Spares ordered now; a second source is qualified under the cost-down work.

risks.problem: Stack leaks at the 30 bar pressure hold

effects.effect: The pressure hold fails and the build is torn down

causes.cause: O-ring groove depth out of tolerance
causes.mitigation: Check groove depth on both end plates before assembly.

planVersions.reason: The leak-test rebuild pushed the 500 h screen a week; added a failure-mode review before close-out.

exp_001.hypothesis: Cell 7 sits more than 15 mV above the stack mean at 2 A/cm².
exp_001.test: Polarization curve on the 10-cell build with per-cell voltage taps, three sweeps.
exp_001.notes: Cells 6 and 8 also read high, by less.

possible_results.label: Outlier confirmed
possible_results.conclusion: Cell 7 is a real outlier. Check compression on cells 6 to 8 first.

possible_results.label: Within normal spread
possible_results.conclusion: No outlier; the first-light reading was noise.

possible_results.label: Voltage tap fault
possible_results.conclusion: A deviation this large is the tap, not the cell. Fix the wiring first.

audit_log.to: Cell 7 is a real outlier. Check compression on cells 6 to 8 first.
audit_log.reason: Added the next check agreed in the build review.

exp_001.name: Map cell voltages at first light

exp_002.hypothesis: Thicker gaskets on cells 6 to 8 under-compress the PTL, which raises contact resistance and the cell 7 voltage.
exp_002.test: Measure every gasket, rebuild with a matched set, rerun the 2 A/cm² hold and log per-cell voltage.

possible_results.label: Compression was the cause
possible_results.conclusion: Matched gaskets fix the outlier; lock the gasket tolerance.

possible_results.label: Cell 7 MEA is the problem
possible_results.conclusion: Compression is fine; the MEA itself is off.

possible_results.label: Both still out of spec
possible_results.conclusion: More than one failure mode. Take it to the FMEA.

exp_002.name: Gasket compression check on cells 6 to 8

exp_003.hypothesis: A replacement MEA from a different lot brings cell 7 within 15 mV of the mean.
exp_003.test: Swap the cell 7 MEA for one from lot 2611, rerun the 2 A/cm² hold.

possible_results.label: Deviation persists
possible_results.conclusion: Not the MEA. Re-map the stack after the swap before changing hardware.

exp_003.name: Swap the cell 7 MEA and retest

exp_004.hypothesis: Cell 7 sits more than 15 mV above the stack mean at 2 A/cm².
exp_004.test: Repeat the first-light polarization curve after the MEA swap, three sweeps, with the taps re-seated.

possible_results.label: Outlier confirmed
possible_results.conclusion: Cell 7 is a real outlier. Check compression on cells 6 to 8 first.

possible_results.label: Within normal spread
possible_results.conclusion: No outlier; the first-light reading was noise.

possible_results.label: Voltage tap fault
possible_results.conclusion: A deviation this large is the tap, not the cell. Fix the wiring first.

exp_001.hypothesis: H₂ in O₂ stays under 1% at 30 bar on the first build.
exp_001.toggle: Nothing varied: first build at 30 bar
exp_001.test: Gas chromatograph on the anode outlet at 30 bar.

possible_results.label: Margin holds
possible_results.conclusion: Crossover is not a risk for the durability campaign.

possible_results.label: Over the limit
possible_results.conclusion: The membrane is too thin for 30 bar.

actual_outcome.note: The gas chromatograph drifted 0.3% during the run.
actual_outcome.conclusion: Recalibrate the GC and repeat before deciding.

exp_002.hypothesis: H₂ in O₂ stays under 1% at 30 bar, fresh and after a 100 h hold.
exp_002.test: Recalibrated gas chromatograph on the anode outlet at 30 bar, at start and after a 100 h hold.

possible_results.label: Margin holds
possible_results.conclusion: Crossover is not a risk for the durability campaign.

possible_results.label: Margin erodes over the hold
possible_results.conclusion: Fresh is fine but it creeps. Try a recombination layer.

possible_results.label: Over the limit when fresh
possible_results.conclusion: The membrane is too thin for 30 bar.

exp_003.hypothesis: A Pt recombination interlayer keeps crossover under 1% through the hold.
exp_003.toggle: Recombination layer: none vs Pt interlayer
exp_003.test: Repeat the 100 h hold at 30 bar with the interlayer MEA.

possible_results.label: Back under 1%
possible_results.conclusion: Adopt the interlayer for the durability build.

possible_results.label: Still over 1%
possible_results.conclusion: Crossover needs a design change. Take it to the FMEA.
